text: - CUID pattern output tightened: [#5880](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5880)
- CUID validation through `z.cuid()` has been tightened, and CUID v1 is now deprecated. Fixed in [#5880](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5880).

- HTTP URL validation through `z.httpUrl()` now rejects malformed HTTP(S) URLs with a missing slash after the protocol. The underlying `URL` constructor normalizes inputs like `https:/example.com`, but Zod now rejects them instead of accepting the repaired URL. Fixed in [#5672](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5672), related to [#5284](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/issues/5284).

section: Union paths are fixed in formatted errors
text: - Nested union paths are now preserved correctly in the output of `z.treeifyError()` and `z.formatError()`. Fixed in [#5708](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5708) and [`60ff3987`](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/commit/60ff398771bb4b6df04d96f00b9a10ee561ee7af).

section: Union paths are fixed in formatted errors
text: - Invalid discriminated union errors now include discriminator options and improved messages. Fixed in [#5723](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5723). This may affect users snapshotting `ZodError` output.
- Key refinement failures now surface as structured `invalid_key` issues. Fixed in [#5719](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5719).
- Non-enumerable properties are skipped more consistently. Fixed in [#5719](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5719).
- The v3-style single-argument `z.record(valueType)` form works again. Fixed in [`0e960108`](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/commit/0e960108f0d98dbea7844a8ff914f0980352f636).
- Encoding through `z.discriminatedUnion().encode()` now works when the discriminator uses a codec. Fixed in [#5769](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5769).
- Codec inversion was added in [#5770](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5770).
- Global configuration is now shared through `globalThis`, improving behavior across mixed CJS/ESM module instances. Fixed in [#5889](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5889).
- Jitless mode now avoids eval probing when set before first access. Fixed in [#5864](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/5864).

- `z.ipv6()` validated by handing the string to `new URL()`, which let `::@1\` and `::1\n` through. It now checks the address alphabet directly ([#6442](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/6442)).

- `z.ulid()` restricts the first character to `0`–`7`; anything higher overflows the 48-bit timestamp. A fixture that doesn't start with a real timestamp, such as one with a leading letter, is now rejected ([#6095](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/6095)).
- `z.httpUrl()` enforces the RFC 1035 length limits on the host, matching `z.hostname()` ([#6035](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/6035)).
- `z.emoji()` no longer backtracks exponentially on a failed match ([#6347](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/6347)).

- `z.string().includes(sub, { position: N })` emits a JSON Schema pattern that allows *at least* N leading characters, matching `String.prototype.includes` ([#6024](https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/6024)).
